category_policy.scope: Route by the behavior changed in the diff, including removed code. A filename, an unchanged nearby call, or a known vulnerability class alone is insufficient. A safe fix can still require a specialist. Choose all applicable routes; low_impact is exclusive. Request missing context instead of inventing it. These are reviewer roles, not named people.

auth_boundary.description: Changes authentication, sessions, authorization, patient or tenant scoping, resource access paths, or their enforcement contracts.

sensitive_data.description: Changes collection, exposure, transmission, storage or access to patient data, secrets or payment credentials. Merely formatting an amount or changing arithmetic in a billing file is insufficient.

construction.description: Changes query construction, parser behavior, shell commands, redirects, or dynamic HTML/JavaScript output. Static wording or layout changes alone are insufficient.

security_config.description: Changes security configuration, cryptographic implementation/settings, or dependency declarations. Calling an existing encryption helper without changing its behavior alone is insufficient.

low_impact.description: A local change with none of the above impacts, such as static wording, layout or local arithmetic. Do not infer this from absence of a detected vulnerability.

decision_rule: Inclusive threshold 0.5 per category. No positive category is abstention; low_impact plus any specialist is unresolved conflict. Preserve specialist obligations while triage is pending.
invariants: Jev adds category signals only. No estimate is approval.
Mandatory repository roles and checks cannot be waived by model or triage.
Approvals and checks must be trusted records for the exact reviewed revision.
Unavailable owner blocks until trusted ownership metadata provides an authorized delegate.
Routing triage can resolve uncertain categories or an exception to model-added obligations with actor, revision and reason; it cannot satisfy a review approval.
